paragraphs: Rami bar Shmuel spoke to Rav Nahman: Ketubbot 97a. He and Rav Yitzhak son of Rav Yehudah studied Niddah at Rav Huna’s academy. Rabbah bar Rav Hina found them (Niddah 17b, where the checked text reads Rabbah bar Rav Huna). Yuhasin, under Shmuel bar Abba the priest, writes that he had a son Rami; thus this is he, and he forgot to mention him in his place.
